resources.string: Tap segments in any order to turn them on and off.
Tap a segment to toggle it
One assignment sets exactly which segments are on.
Use case: a weekly habit tracker
Seven divisions, one per day. Missed days stay off.
setDivisionProgress: finished chapters are full, the current one is 40% through. Progress 1 is exactly enableDivision.
setDivisionColor gives one division its own colour, superseding progressBarColor for that division only. This bar also sets spb_perDivisionAccessibility, so a screen reader steps through its cells.
isDividerEnabled=false, so adjacent segments that are on merge into a single run.
spb_inactiveHeightRatio=0.7, off segments sit slightly inset so the on segments read as raised. Both default to the same height; either can be the smaller.
spb_cornerMode=eachSegment, every cell is its own pill, lit or not.
spb_cornerMode=eachRun, so each run of adjacent segments becomes a single pill.
spb_shadowRadius with an offset. Drawn outside the bar and never resizing it, so the view carries padding to give the blur room.
spb_segmentAnimation=fade, with spb_tapToToggle so the bar handles the tap itself. Tap a segment to see it cross-fade in and out.
spb_segmentAnimation=grow. Tap a segment to see it extend from its leading edge.
The same set under layoutDirection=rtl. Segment 0 sits at the right, so the pattern mirrors.
The track is inset by the view\'s padding; the tinted area is the full view bounds.
Falls back to an intrinsic 144dp × 8dp instead of collapsing to nothing.
